The source nevertheless contains an authored error in q-159706: its final evaluation labels the derivative as ∂f/∂x, although the question and preceding derivation concern ∂f/∂y. The requested y derivative is 2; the actual x derivative at (π,-π) is 0. There is no disagreement with the selected answer 2. Also, q-122629's explanation quotes a distractor different from the current choice, without affecting its correct conclusion. Mathematical checks: q-132561 integrates 3y over 0≤y≤2 and y/2≤x≤√(5−y²), giving [−(5−y²)^(3/2)−y³/2]₀²=5√5−5. The negative intersection obtained after squaring is extraneous to x=√(5−y²)=y/2 and irrelevant to the depicted region. q-75659 has an upper triangular reduced coefficient matrix with three nonzero pivots, so only the trivial solution exists and II and III are true. q-122752 gives vectors (1,2), (1,2), and (−4,−8) at (1,3), (−1,−1), and (3,2), matching option 4. q-122754 gives (1,−3), (−2,2), and (−5,4) at (−5,3), (0,0), and (2,−3), matching option 2. q-122629 has a positive constant horizontal component and vertical component proportional to x, matching i+xj. q-122631 has zero horizontal component and vertical component −y. q-122664 shows equal upward vectors parallel to z, matching 2k. q-123749 shows equal vectors in the negative y direction; none of the listed functions matches. q-84015 uses Var[X]=7/2−(1/2)²=13/4. q-84296 has E[X]=9/2 and E[X²]=51/2, hence variance 21/4 and standard deviation √21/2. q-159659 uses the logarithm chain rule to obtain (1+3x²y)/(x+x³y). q-159658 uses the cosine and square-root chain rules to obtain −x sin(√(2xy−1))/√(2xy−1) on the interior of the real domain. q-159766 has f_y=√(x²+y²)+y²/√(x²+y²), yielding 14/3. q-159753 has f_x=2x tan(xy²)+x²y² sec²(xy²), yielding π/2+π²/8=(π²+4π)/8. q-159707 rewrites f=(x²−y²)e^(x−y), so f_x=(2x+x²−y²)e^(x−y), yielding 2e². q-159706 has f_y=2 cos(x)cos(y)/(cos(x)−sin(y))², yielding 2.",
